pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed polygonal regions with highly serrated, non-linear edges and sharp pixel-level transitions between pigment and base coat.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Complex reticulated web of narrow cream-colored pathways with frequent multi-directional junctions and high topological connectivity across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette formed by a short, bristly mane along the dorsal midline of the neck.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp diagonal shadow is cast across the central torso and flank by the neck of a second, overlapping individual.
